description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in product management or a related technical role.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 7 years of experience in product management or a related technical role.
* 2 years of experience taking technical products from concept to launch.
* Experience with Growth in a fast paced environment (especially in Consumer facing Mobile first areas).
* Experience and interest in building large-scale platforms.

**About the job**
-----------------

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
  
  
In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.  
  
One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

  

As a Product Manager leading the Transit and Mobile Recharge verticals within Google Pay (GPay) India, you will own the overall direction, strategy, and execution for two of GPay's highest-frequency engagement drivers. In this role, you will define end-to-end product roadmaps across daily-commute transit experiences as well as Mobile Recharge product strategy and growth across - Platform, AI experiences, UX, performance and more. You will serve as the core strategic owner bridging product innovation, internal cross-functional execution (Engineering, UX, Analytics, Legal, Business Development), and critical external ecosystem partnerships with Telecom companies, Aggregators, regulators, public transport operators, and more to scale daily and monthly usage and engagement amongst users across India.

Whether it is paying online with Autofill, using tap and pay in stores, or using the Google Pay app, the Payments team at Google is focused on making payments simple, seamless, and secure. In addition to consumer payment technologies, the Payments team also powers the money movement between Google and its consumers and businesses.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Define and execute the multi-year product strategy for Transit and Mobile Recharge verticals on GPay India, translating complex daily utility needs and regulatory standards into intuitive, high-scale GPay experiences.
* Lead the end to end product portfolio across Growth, Platformization, Scalability, Reliability, Obsersability, AI experiences and new opportunities at massive scale.
* Lead buildout of the Transit space on GPay —driving initiatives across NCMC, QR Ticketing and other first-party and third-party experiences.
* Establish a close working relationship with key ecosystem partners (NPCI, Bharat Connect, aggregators, issuers and others) to navigate compliance , unblock technical dependencies, and lead cross-functional growth tracks to eliminate funnel friction and maximize user engagement.

We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. **In this role, you will:**

* Lead one or more product teams in delivering business and customer value through execution of product initiatives aligned with established product strategies and roadmaps.
* Own and prioritize the product backlog, ensuring alignment with business priorities, customer needs, risk requirements, and regulatory commitments.
* Collaborate with L2/L3 Product Managers and stakeholders to translate strategic objectives into actionable epics, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Drive backlog refinement, sprint planning, release planning, product reviews, and demonstrations to ensure effective execution and delivery.
* Partner with technology, architecture, operations, and business teams to define solutions and ensure successful implementation of product enhancements and capabilities.

* Manage cross-functional dependencies, identify delivery risks, remove impediments, and drive timely resolution of issues impacting product delivery.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**About the Team**

Product Management in Meesho closely resembles our rocketship growth. Because we obsess over understanding customer behaviour, we’ve been able to carve out an e-commerce niche in Tier 2/3/4 towns in Bharat. Our business growth is testimony to a singular focus on how we think of ‘product’ for our unique customers - ones that have barely shopped online, but are now able to because of Meesho.

Fun fact: Nearly 7% of India’s households shop with us.

We are driven by a ‘user-first’ mindset. We have a strong bias for action. Above all, our team is driven by impact, not features. We drive ‘problem discovery’ & delivery - not only obsess over “what to build”, but execute with rigour to create impact.

But there’s more – we love to have fun as much as we love to work hard. From movie buffs, to sportspersons, we have a super cool team. So, if a game of badminton after a day of brainstorming at work sounds like something you would love to do, then join us!

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager who is passionate about solving high impact problems in a fast paced start-up environment with a high degree of autonomy. This is inherently a cross-functional leadership role where you will work closely with teams such as software engineering, UX design, category mgmt., marketing, operations, finance, etc to bring a new product to life.

### **What will you do**

* Market & Customer Understanding: Understand the e-commerce market and needs of customers/sellers deeply through landscape analysis, customer interviews, user research, competition analysis and other qualitative/quantitative techniques.
* Problem Identification & Prioritization: Adopt a structured approach to identify what problems need to be solved and break them down into smaller chunks. Prioritize what problems need to be solved now vs. later.
* Solution Discovery: Facilitate a process to come up with the best technology-led ideas to solve the prioritized problems. Harness the creativity of not just yourself but of other teams such as design, engg., business, etc. Be willing to experiment with multiple solution ideas and test them using MVPs, prototypes, etc.
* Product Delivery: Define detailed product requirements and work collaboratively with a cross-functional team (design, engineering, business, analytics, etc.) to bring a product to life. Ensure high product quality through processes such as user acceptance testing, dogfooding, etc.
* Go-to-Market Planning: Create a go-to-market plan working with business/marketing stakeholders to maximize product adoption and success.
* Adoption & Metrics: Define product metrics for your area, and track them continuously. Identify usage patterns and come up with action plans to move metrics in the right direction.
* Roadmap Creation: Create a product roadmap for your area that has at least a 3-month forward looking view of key customer/business problems to be solved.
* Team Leadership: Manage a small team of product analysts and associate product managers, and guide them towards product execution.

### **What you will need**

* Overall experience of 7+ yrs with atleast 5+ yrs in product management in a tech-led company (consumer internet space is preferred)
* Exceptional problem solving skills based on first principles thinking
* Good understanding of technology, and comfort with product management processes such as A/B experimentation, writing product requirement documents, managing product backlogs, and creating roadmaps

### **About us**

Welcome to Meesho, where every story begins with a spark of inspiration and a dash of entrepreneurial spirit. We're not just a platform; we're your partner in turning dreams into realities.

**Curious about life at Meesho? Explore our Glassdoor - our people have a lot to say and they've helped us become a loved workplace in India.**

### **Our Mission**

Democratising internet commerce for everyone — Meesho (Meri Shop) started with a single idea in mind: to be an e-commerce destination for Indian consumers and to enable small businesses to succeed online.

We provide our sellers with benefits such as zero commission and affordable shipping solutions in the market. Today, sellers nationwide are growing their businesses by tapping into Meesho’s large and diverse customer base, state-of-the-art tech infrastructure, and pan-India logistics network through trusted third-party partners.

Affordable, relatable merchandise that mirrors local markets has helped us connect with internet users and serve customers across urban, semi-urban, and rural India. Our unique business model and continuous innovation have established us as a part of India’s e-commerce ecosystem.

### **Culture and Total Rewards**

Our focus is on cultivating a dynamic workplace characterized by high impact and performance excellence. We prioritize a people-centric culture, dedicated to hiring and developing exceptional talent.

Total rewards at Meesho comprise a comprehensive set of elements — monetary, non-monetary, tangible, and intangible. Our 9 guiding principles, or "Mantras," are the backbone of how we operate, influencing everything from recognition and evaluation to growth discussions. Daily rituals and processes like “Problem First Mindset,” “Listen or Die,” our Internal Mobility Program, Talent Reviews, and Continuous Performance Management embody these principles.

We offer competitive compensation — both cash and equity-based — tailored to job roles, individual experience, and skill, along with employee-centric benefits and a supportive work environment. Our holistic wellness program, MeeCare, includes benefits across physical, mental, financial, and social wellness. This includes extensive medical insurance for employees and their families, wellness initiatives like telehealth, wellness events, and fitness-related perks.

To support work-life balance, we offer generous leave policies, parental support, retirement benefits, and learning and development assistance. Through personalized recognition, gratitude for stretched work, and engaging activities, we promote employee delight at the workplace. Additional benefits such as salary advance support, relocation assistance, and flexible benefit plans further enrich the Meesho experience.

At Meesho, we are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace where every individual can thrive. In compliance with the **Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016**, we uphold the following principles:

* **Equal Opportunity**: We ensure that employment opportunities are never denied on the grounds of disability if the candidate is otherwise competent to perform the job.
* **Accessible Workplace**: Our facilities are designed to be fully accessible, with amenities and assistive devices provided to support differently abled individuals in their work.
* **Inclusive Hiring Process**: We adopt a transparent and non-discriminatory selection process, including providing application forms in alternate formats and offering reasonable accommodations during interviews upon request.
* **Career Growth**: We provide adequate training post-recruitment and pre-promotion, with training materials available in accessible formats to enable equal career progression.
* **Support & Confidentiality**: A dedicated liaison officer/committee addresses concerns and grievances, while maintaining strict confidentiality of disability-related information.
* **Awareness & Inclusion**: We conduct awareness programs to promote a culture of inclusivity across the organization.

Meesho welcomes applicants and employees of all abilities and is dedicated to fostering an environment where differently abled persons can achieve their full potential.

Know more about Meesho here : https://www.meesho.io/

Launched in 2007 by Aloke Bajpai & Rajnish Kumar, ixigo (Le Travenues Technology Limited) is a technology company focused on empowering Indian travellers to plan, book and manage their trips across rail, air, buses and hotels. ixigo assists travellers in making smarter travel decisions by leveraging artificial intelligence. The ixigo, ConfirmTkt and AbhiBus apps allow travellers to book train tickets, flight tickets, bus tickets, hotels, and cabs, and provide travel utility tools and services developed using in-house proprietary algorithms and crowd-sourced information. With over 54 crore Annual Active Users in Fiscal 2025, ixigo is the leading OTA for Next Billion Users in India. For more information, please visit http://www.ixigo.com

 **Job Description**

**About the Role:**

As a Product Manager - Flights at ixigo, you will work on the end-to-end flights product, driving growth across the booking funnel while ensuring a reliable, trustworthy experience across the customer journey.

You will balance user experience, business growth, and operational efficiency across a high-volume, high-stakes product area.

**Responsibilities:**

* Flights Product Strategy: Define and execute the roadmap for the flights business, balancing growth, conversion, and customer experience priorities across the funnel
* Post-Booking Experience: Own key post-booking journeys including cancellations, rescheduling, and refunds, working with CX teams to identify and resolve recurring customer pain points
* Booking Funnel Optimization: Own and continuously improve the search-to-book funnel, search relevance, seat/meal selection, add-ons — to reduce drop-offs and improve conversion at every step
* Partner Onboarding & Distribution: Lead the onboarding of new airlines, GDS/NDC partners, and supply sources to expand flight inventory. Additionally, own the B2B API distribution charter — onboarding partners who wish to integrate our flight APIs to sell flights on their own platforms, defining API/product requirements, and ensuring smooth technical and commercial integration for these partners
* Continuous Experimentation: Champion A/B testing across search, discounting, and checkout flows to systematically improve conversion and revenue metrics
* Cross-functional Collaboration: Act as the central node between Design, Backend, Frontend, Analytics, and the AI/ML teams. You will translate complex business needs into PRDs and user-centric designs
* Data-Driven Optimization: Define and track North Star metrics such as funnel conversion rate, supply coverage, partner integration TAT, and customer satisfaction, using these insights to guide roadmap decisions

 **Qualifications**

**Qualifications:**

* 2-5 years of experience in Product Management, ideally within a high-growth B2C tech company, OTA, or travel-tech setting. Experience with funnel optimization, marketplace/supply growth, or partner integrations is a strong plus
* Funnel & Growth Mindset: Strong understanding of conversion funnels and the ability to identify and prioritize high-impact optimizations across search, pricing, and checkout
* User-Centric Mindset: An eye for great UX/UI and a solid understanding of the end-to-end travel booking experience, including post-booking needs
* Technical Fluency: Comfortable discussing API/integration structures with backend teams and airline/GDS systems
* Execution Excellence: Proven ability to manage complex, cross-functional projects with multiple stakeholders and ship reliable, high-quality features in an agile environment

**Additional (Preferred):**

* OTA Experience: Familiarity with the nuances of the Indian travel market and seasonal booking patterns
* Partnership & Integration Acumen: Comfort working with airline/GDS/NDC partners and translating commercial and technical integration requirements into a clear onboarding roadmap
* AI/ML Exposure: Direct experience working with data science teams to deploy machine learning models
* Growth Mindset: A "hacker" mentality—constantly looking for small tweaks that lead to outsized gains in conversion

title: Product Manager – B2B SaaS
description:
**Company:** iFieldSmart Technologies LLC

**Position:** Product Manager

**Experience:** Experienced professional with a B2B SaaS background

**1. Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced, proactive, and execution-oriented Product Manager who will act as a central coordination point between the Sales, Marketing, Product Coordination, and Product Development functions.

The primary responsibility of this role is to take end-to-end ownership of product delivery commitments made to clients by the Sales team and ensure that products currently under development are completed, made market-ready, and successfully handed over to the Marketing team for launch.

The individual will work closely with our existing Product Coordinators, Project Managers, and Program Managers, who are responsible for managing individual products and development programs and coordinating with engineering management and development teams.

The new Product Manager will oversee and coordinate across these program owners, track overall progress, ensure alignment on priorities and deadlines, proactively identify bottlenecks, and take ownership of ensuring that business commitments are fulfilled.

This is a highly coordination-driven and ownership-oriented role requiring someone who can manage multiple priorities, work with cross-functional teams, proactively identify challenges, and drive timely execution.

**2. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Client-Specific Product Delivery Management**

· Take complete ownership of product delivery commitments made by the Sales team to different clients.

· Coordinate with the respective Product Coordinators, Project Managers, and Program Managers responsible for the development of those products or features.

· Ensure that client-specific requirements, priorities, and committed delivery timelines are clearly communicated to the respective program owners.

· Maintain proactive tracking of multiple ongoing client deliveries, milestones, dependencies, and deadlines across different programs.

· Regularly follow up with the respective coordinators and program managers to understand development progress and identify potential delays or roadblocks.

· Proactively identify risks, resolve coordination bottlenecks, and escalate critical issues to senior management whenever required.

· Maintain clear communication and alignment between Sales, Marketing, and Product/Program Management teams regarding delivery status, changes, and expectations.

· Ensure that client commitments are not just tracked but successfully fulfilled, taking full accountability for overall delivery outcomes.

**B. Product Completion & Market Launch Management**

· Take ownership of existing products and features that are in the development or finalization stage.

· Work closely with the respective Product Coordinators and Program Managers to ensure pending development activities are completed.

· Track product readiness, identify gaps, and drive closure of pending requirements before launch.

· Coordinate with the concerned program owners to ensure product testing, quality checks, and final readiness activities are completed.

· Ensure completed products and features are properly documented and handed over to the Marketing team.

· Work closely with Marketing to communicate product capabilities, features, use cases, and launch requirements.

· Ensure products are ready for marketing campaigns, customer demonstrations, and commercial rollout.

· Track the overall product launch pipeline and ensure products do not remain indefinitely in the development or finalization stage.

**C. Cross-Functional Coordination & Stakeholder Management**

· Act as the central coordination point between Sales, Marketing, and the existing Product Coordination / Program Management teams.

· Work closely with multiple Product Coordinators, Project Managers, and Program Managers, each responsible for managing different products or development programs.

· Maintain visibility into the progress of all ongoing product development initiatives and client-specific commitments.

· Ensure business priorities, client requirements, and deadlines are aligned with the respective program owners.

· Conduct regular follow-ups and status reviews to ensure timely execution.

· Proactively identify dependencies, delays, resource constraints, and risks that could impact product delivery.

· Coordinate with the relevant program owners to resolve bottlenecks and escalate critical issues to senior management, engineering management, or the CEO whenever necessary.

· Keep senior management informed about delivery progress, critical dependencies, risks, and challenges.

· Ensure smooth information flow between technical and non-technical teams.

**Important clarification about the role:** The Product Manager will primarily coordinate with the existing Product Coordinators, Project Managers, and Program Managers rather than directly managing developers or assigning day-to-day technical development tasks. The respective program owners will continue to manage development execution through engineering management and development teams. However, the new Product Manager will be accountable for tracking and driving overall delivery outcomes.

**3. Candidate Profile & Required Experience**

We are specifically looking for someone with:

· Experience working in a B2B SaaS product company.

· Exposure to international markets and experience working with international clients or customers, preferably the US market.

· Previous experience working in a startup or fast-growing technology company.

· Experience coordinating cross-functional teams, particularly Sales, Product, Program Management, and Engineering functions.

· Experience in product delivery management, program coordination, product operations, or product management.

· Strong project execution, delivery management, and stakeholder management capabilities.

· Ability to manage multiple projects, client commitments, products, and deadlines simultaneously.

· Experience tracking deliverables through multiple project or program owners.

· A proactive approach to identifying problems, following up, and ensuring things get completed.

**4. Preferred Mindset & Additional Requirements**

· Flexible and adaptable to a fast-paced startup environment.

· Willingness to multitask and take ownership beyond narrowly defined responsibilities.

· Strong execution-oriented mindset rather than just planning and reporting.

· Ability and willingness to learn the technical aspects of AI-powered products and solutions.

· Willingness to understand the construction technology industry and its workflows.

· Good communication, coordination, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

· Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

· Ability to work independently, drive accountability, and ensure follow-through without requiring constant supervision.

**5. What We Are Looking For**

The ideal candidate should be able to ensure that:

1. Whatever Sales commits to clients gets delivered within the agreed timelines.

2. All existing Product Coordinators and Program Managers are aligned with business priorities and client delivery commitments.

3. The overall progress of multiple products and development programs is proactively tracked.

4. Potential delivery issues, dependencies, and bottlenecks are identified and addressed before they become major problems.

5. Senior management has clear visibility into product delivery progress and potential risks.

6. Products nearing completion are driven towards launch readiness.

7. Marketing receives completed, properly documented products and features for successful market launches.

8. There is clear coordination and accountability between all business and product-related teams.

**The ideal candidate is an execution-focused Product Manager who can connect business commitments with internal product execution, coordinate multiple program owners, and take complete ownership of getting things delivered.**

Pay: ₹400,000.00 - ₹2,500,000.00 per year

description:
**About the Role**

We're looking for an Associate Product Manager with 1–2 years of experience who is excited about building user-focused products and solving real customer problems. You'll work closely with Product, Engineering, Data, and Business teams to take ideas from discovery to execution and continuously improve the product experience.

This role is ideal for someone who is analytical, curious, highly execution-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.

Location: Vasant Kunj, Delhi - Hybrid

**What you'll do**

*Understand the problem*

* Talk to users regularly. Run interviews, sit in on support and sales calls, watch people use the product, and read the feedback nobody else reads.
* Separate what users ask for from what they actually need, and turn scattered input into a clear, prioritized problem list.
* Bring evidence, not opinions. Every proposal should trace back to something a real user said or did.

*Build and design*

* Turn ideas into clickable prototypes using AI tools like Claude, Lovable, or whatever gets you to a real interaction fastest, so users, stakeholders, engineers, and QA can all experience the thing before it's built.
* Design the experience end to end: the main flow, the empty states, the error messages, the edge cases.
* Use AI to multiply your output. Synthesizing research, building internal tools, analyzing data, testing ideas in an afternoon instead of a sprint.
* Help ship AI-powered features, and think hard about what happens when the model gets it wrong.

*Own delivery*

* Keep a clear, prioritized backlog for your area. Be able to explain why something is next, including what you're not doing and why.
* Write short and plainly: the problem, the user, one success metric, what's in scope and what isn't.
* Work with engineering and QA through backlog grooming, sprint planning, and QA. Answer questions, resolve ambiguity, test the release yourself before it ships.
* Help plan and run launches with the people who need to know: support, sales, marketing, and leadership.

**What we're looking for**

* **A portfolio we can open:** Projects, tools, prototypes, or products you've built.
* **User curiosity:** You open an app and can't help asking why people keep coming back to it, and what you'd steal.
* **AI fluency:** You've gone past basic prompting. You know how to give a model the right context, you've seen where models fail, and you've thought about what to do about it.
* **Taste:** Shown two versions of a screen, you can say which is better and explain why in terms of the user. You notice layout, hierarchy, spacing, and what a screen does when it's empty or broken.
* **Comfort with data:** You can pull numbers out of a sheet or a dashboard, spot when something looks off, and back a conclusion with them.
* **Clear thinking under ambiguity:** You can break a vague problem into something testable.
* **Strong communication:** You can explain a decision to an engineer, a designer, and a business stakeholder without changing the substance.
* **Attention to detail:** In the product, and in your own work.

**Nice to have**

* You've written an eval, or tuned LLM model settings and can say what changed.
* Fluency in Figma, or formal design training.
* Hands-on time with an analytics tool (Mixpanel, Amplitude, Metabase, GA).
* A side project with real users you didn't have to recruit.
* Interest in education, careers, or working with students.

No MBA required. No prior PM title required. If you're short on experience, product depth and the drive to build make up for it. What matters is what you've built.

Our platform spans the Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, the Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises, and the Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform, using cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to bring together vehicle manufacturers, dealerships, and consumers. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia, and Europe.
  
  
**About the Role**
  
  
Tekion connects dealerships - the businesses that sell and service vehicles - with the automakers that build those vehicles, such as General Motors, Honda, or Ford. Across the industry these automakers are referred to as OEMs (Original Equipment Manufacturers). The software on each side needs to exchange information automatically and reliably: vehicle orders, inventory, repair records, customer details, and much more. The software that makes this exchange happen is called integration. We are seeking a driven, technically curious Product Manager I to join our Integrations team. You will take ownership of one integration pattern - a family of similar integrations that share the same shape (for example, all the integrations that send vehicle service and repair data to automakers). Your mission is to make every integration in that family measurably healthy and best-in-class, shift more of its delivery from manual building to AI-assisted building, and make sure dealerships actually adopt and benefit from it. This is a hands-on role for an early-career product manager who is comfortable with technical concepts, motivated by measurable outcomes, and excited to help modernize how a decades-old industry connects its software. You will work closely with Engineering, Design, and senior product managers, who will guide and mentor you as you grow into full ownership of your integration pattern.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
  
  

* Keep your integrations healthy and best-in-class: Define what “good” looks like for your integration pattern, measure it in our Integration Platform (Tekion’s internal health-monitoring system), and drive coverage, reliability, and quality up across all your integrations - benchmarking each against the best competing product in the market.

  

* Win on AI-powered delivery: Shift your pattern from hand-built integrations toward ones generated with Tekion’s AI-assisted build tools (internally, APC Studio), help sharpen the AI tools you depend on, and own a complete, living set of requirements that any engineering team can build from.

  

* Drive revenue through OEM certifications: Lead integration patterns toward successful OEM certification so OEM-approved integrations can be adopted by dealers at scale. Drive adoption and reduce support load: Make your integrations easy to install and switch on, raise dealership uptake where it is low, and reduce support tickets by tracking and fixing root causes.

  

* Partner across teams: Translate the needs of dealers, automakers, and partners into clear requirements, and work day-to-day with Engineering, Design, Support, and Go-to-Market teams to deliver, launch, and measure impact.

  
**What We’re Looking For**
  
  

* Around 3+ years of product management experience, or equivalent experience in a technical product, integration, API, or platform role. Strong early-career candidates with a technical background are encouraged to apply.

  

* Exposure to integrations, APIs, or platform and marketplace products, with the ability to read technical documentation and discuss APIs, webhooks, and data flows with engineers. (An API is a defined way for two systems to exchange data; a webhook is an automatic notification one system sends another when something happens. You do not need to write code.)

  

* A strong bias toward measurable outcomes, with comfort using dashboards, metrics, and data to set targets and track progress.

  
• Clear writing skills - the ability to turn messy, ambiguous requirements into crisp specifications and user stories. • Curiosity about AI and how it can automate technical work, plus the drive to improve the tools you use.
  
  

* Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work with both technical and non-technical audiences.

  

* The ability to manage ambiguity, prioritize effectively, and make thoughtful trade-offs in a fast-paced environment.

  

* A bachelor’s degree in business, computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  
**Nice to Have**
  
  

* Interest in or exposure to AI agents, large language models (LLMs), and automated workflows.

  

* Familiarity with the automotive retail world - dealerships, the Dealer Management System (DMS, the core software a dealership runs its business on), or automaker (OEM) certification programs.

  
**Why Join Us**  
  

* Modernize an industry: Help modernize how an entire industry connects its software, moving from slow, hand-built integrations to a fast, AI-powered delivery model.

  

* Work at the frontier of AI delivery: Be hands-on with how AI is used to scope, build, and test real enterprise integrations.

  

* See measurable impact: Own clear, measurable goals and watch your work show up directly in integration health, adoption, and support metrics.

  

* Grow with mentorship: Learn from senior product managers and engineers, with a clear path to grow into broader ownership.

**Overview**

Small businesses drive the global economy. In the US, SMBs employ 60% of the labor force and create 80% of new jobs. In an environment where time is money, precise time tracking for payroll, invoicing, and project management is the critical lever for maintaining profitability and growing the business.

We are seeking a Staff Product Manager to lead the verticalization of QuickBooks Time. You’ll make our time tracking platform the system of record for hours, labor cost, and payroll in the industries where labor is the highest cost, starting with construction and field services. Time is the source of hours for the entire QuickBooks ecosystem. Customers use the hours their teams track to run payroll, bill for their work, and understand whether each job is making money, and the mid-market businesses we serve need all three to work together without spreadsheets or re-entry.

This is a high-ownership role. You will own three connected areas end to end: time to payroll, so approved hours, overtime, and pay items flow into QuickBooks Payroll accurately and automagically; job costing, so every hour tracked produces labor cost estimates against projects and budgets before payroll runs and accurate actuals after it; and worker time tracking across Workforce Web, Workforce Kiosk, and the Workforce mobile app, where millions of workers track their time. You will build on Time 2.0, our rebuilt time platform that now lives inside QuickBooks Online, and extend it so that serving a new industry is mostly configuration rather than new code.

We need a scrappy, customer-obsessed product leader who leads through influence. Someone who navigates dependencies across Payroll, Projects, Mid-Market, and Payments, earns the trust and confidence of our customers and accountants, and ships experiences that delight both the worker clocking in on a job site and the admin who approves time and runs payroll.

**Responsibilities**

**Responsibilities**

* **Vertical Strategy.** Own the multi-year roadmap for verticalizing QuickBooks Time, starting with construction and field services. Translate how each industry runs its labor (jobs, cost codes, phases, and certified payroll on a construction site; jobs, visits, and dispatch in field services) into shared platform concepts and configurable experiences, so that each new vertical is mostly configuration rather than new code. Decide what we build, what we configure, and where partner integrations fill the gap.
* **Time to Payroll.** Own the flow of hours from clock-in to paycheck. Make approved time, overtime and break policies, and pay items land in QuickBooks Payroll accurately and automatically, with no exports, syncs, or re-entry, and make approvals fast and trustworthy for a mid-market company with hundreds of employees.
* **Job Costing: Estimates and Actuals.** Deliver real-time labor costing that owners, project managers, and accountants trust. Partner with Projects, Payroll, and Accounting so that time is the single source of hours for payroll, invoicing, and profitability reporting.
* **Worker Time Tracking.** Own how workers track time across Workforce Web, Workforce Kiosk, and the Workforce mobile app, where millions of workers already track their hours. Deliver one consistent, reliable experience for clocking in and out, breaks, schedules, geofencing, and job and task selection that holds up on a job site with poor connectivity and for crews whose first language is not English, and complete the migration of workers off legacy TSheets surfaces onto the new platform.
* **Commercial Impact.** Own the metrics for your area: Time adoption within Workforce Premium and Elite offerings, attached in mid-market and industry editions. Plus worker engagement across web, kiosk, and mobile. Use data and customer evidence to prioritize, measure what ships, and make Time and real-time job costing a central part of how QuickBooks is sold to construction and field services customers, a market where competitors generate $150M+ ARR.
* **Operational Velocity.** Run the end-to-end product lifecycle for your area: write crisp requirements, pressure-test designs, manage edge cases, and drive alignment across engineering, design, data, go-to-market, and customer success teams in the US and India. You lead through influence rather than authority, and you are fluent in AI-native tools like Claude and Cursor, using them to move faster from insight to shipped product.

Spend time with customers on their job sites and with the accountants who recommend HCM products to their clients, and make sure every feature removes a real pain point in how they bid, schedule, track, pay, and get paid.

**Qualifications**

**Qualifications**

You have a proven track record of building and scaling customer-facing products in HCM, workforce management, construction or field service software, or fintech.

* **Domain Depth.** You understand how labor-intensive businesses run: how hours become payroll, how time, cost rates, and pay types become job costs, and how estimates compare to actuals. Experience with payroll, time and attendance, job costing, or construction and field service workflows is a strong advantage.
* **A Proven Growth Driver.** You have a track record of spearheading complex initiatives that deliver measurable business growth. You understand the levers of adoption, attach, ARPC, and retention, and you use them to prioritize and to drive P&L growth.

You are scrappy and effective at managing a portfolio of bets across the lifecycle, from 0-1 innovations to products at scale. You know when to push forward and when to pivot based on evidence and stakeholder feedback.
* **Customer Obsessed & Analytical.** You possess deep empathy for small and mid-market business operations and frontline workforce challenges. You combine this heart with rigorous analytical aptitude, storytelling with data to prioritize investments.
* **Technical Fluency.** You demonstrate strong product judgment and comfort engaging across technical topics to build reliable web, mobile, and kiosk products on a shared platform, including APIs, data models, and integrations with payroll and accounting systems. ##### **Role Purpose**

Own the assigned product portfolio from market discovery and emerging product
  
identification through specification finalisation, development, certification, launch
  
and lifecycle management. Turn market insights into differentiated products and bring
  
clear recommendations to management on product priorities, investment and
  
sourcing.

##### **Key responsibilities**

**Market research and stakeholder engagement:**

* Conduct structured market surveys, customer interviews and site visits to identify
    
  unmet needs, buying criteria and deployment challenges.
* Engage customers to understand operational needs, consultants to understand
    
  specification and compliance expectations, and Master System Integrators (MSIs)
    
  to assess integration and deployment requirements.
* Work with Sales and Presales to validate demand and consolidate feedback from
    
  active opportunities, tenders, demos and deployments.

**Emerging markets and new product identification:**

* Track emerging technologies, applications and procurement trends across Smart
    
  & Safe Cities, intelligent traffic management, video analytics and enterprise
    
  security.
* Identify new hardware, software and integrated product opportunities, including
    
  adjacent markets where Vehant can build on its existing technology, customer
    
  relationships or channel partnerships.
* Validate shortlisted opportunities with customers, consultants and MSIs.
    
  Establish the target buyer, problem to solve, willingness to pay and likely route to
    
  market.
* Build business cases covering demand, revenue potential, differentiation,
    
  technical feasibility, development and sourcing costs, certification requirements
    
  and time to market.
* Recommend whether to build, source or partner. Define measurable pilot success
    
  criteria for approved concepts.

**Competition analysis and product differentiation:**

* Benchmark competing products on functionality, field performance, integration,
    
  certifications, pricing and total cost of ownership.
* Use competitive gaps and customer feedback to define new unique selling
    
  propositions (USPs) with measurable customer benefits.
* Validate proposed USPs through comparative testing, demonstrations or field
    
  pilots and equip Sales and Presales with the evidence to communicate them.

**Product roadmap and specification finalisation:**

* Own and prioritise the hardware and software roadmap based on customer
    
  demand, commercial potential, technical feasibility and resource availability.
* Finalise product specifications with Development, Technical, IT and Quality
    
  teams. Cover performance, interfaces, interoperability, cybersecurity,
    
  environmental conditions and deployment constraints as applicable
* Define measurable acceptance criteria and secure cross-functional sign-off before
    
  development or sourcing commitments. Assess the cost, schedule and compliance
    
  impact of subsequent specification changes.

**Cross-functional execution, launch and lifecycle management:**

* Work with Sales and Presales on positioning and opportunity feedback,
    
  Development on feasibility and release delivery, Technical and Service teams on
    
  field validation and supportability, and IT on infrastructure, cybersecurity and
    
  deployment readiness.
* Coordinate prototypes, proofs of concept, field trials and release readiness
    
  reviews. Resolve dependencies and escalate decisions that affect scope, cost or
    
  timelines.
* Drive launch readiness through datasheets, compliance matrices, demonstrations,
    
  release notes and training for Sales, Presales and Service.
* Track adoption, field performance and recurring service issues. Use the findings
    
  to prioritise enhancements, upgrades and end-of-life decisions.

**Certifications, testing and compliance:**

* Identify applicable standards, certifications and tender-related compliance
    
  requirements for each product. Incorporate them into specifications, test plans
    
  and release schedules
* Coordinate testing and documentation with Development, Quality, vendors and
    
  external laboratories or certification agencies. Track gaps, corrective actions, test
    
  evidence and approvals through closure.
* Maintain a product-wise compliance matrix and track certificate validity,
    
  renewals and the impact of hardware, firmware or software changes on existing
    
  approvals.

**Vendor communication and sourcing optimisation:**

* Lead product and technical discussions with OEMs, component suppliers and
    
  technology partners. Evaluate samples, capabilities, customisation options and
    
  support commitments.
* Work with Procurement, Development and Quality to optimise bill-of-materials
    
  cost and lead times, qualify alternate sources and reduce single-source
    
  dependencies.
* Validate sourcing changes against agreed specifications, field reliability, warranty
    
  implications and certification requirements before approval.

**Monthly management review and reporting:**

* Prepare and circulate a monthly product report covering emerging product
    
  opportunities, market and competitor developments, roadmap milestones,
    
  specification sign-offs, pilots, certification status, sourcing metrics, risks and
    
  decisions required.
* Lead the monthly management review. Present options, trade-offs and a
    
  recommendation for each decision on which opportunities to pursue, defer or
    
  close, along with decisions on roadmap priorities, investment, specification
    
  changes, certification spend, vendor selection and launch readiness.
* Record decisions, action owners and due dates. Track actions to closure and
    
  escalate blockers that require attention before the next review.

##### **Experience & Qualifications**

* 10–12 years of experience in B2B technology, with demonstrated ownership of
    
  hardware and software products or integrated solutions.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline. An MBA is
    
  desirable.
* Experience in intelligent traffic systems, smart or safe cities, surveillance, AI
    
  video analytics, industrial IoT or embedded systems is preferred.

##### **Core Capabilities**

* Proven ability to identify and validate new market opportunities and take
    
  products from specification through pilot, certification, launch and post-launch
    
  review.
* Experience engaging customers, consultants and system integrators and
    
  translating their inputs into product and commercial decisions.
* Working knowledge of vendor qualification, product costing, alternate sourcing
    
  and compliance documentation.
* Ability to influence cross-functional teams and present concise, evidence-based
    
  recommendations to senior management.

title: Senior Product Manager I
description:
**Senior Product Manager - Search & Analytics Platform**

  

Sumo Logic is hiring a Senior Product Manager to own the data, query, and context foundations that help customers and AI agents understand and act on operational and security telemetry.

Effective investigation depends on finding the right data, querying it efficiently, and understanding how it relates to the customer's environment. As AI agents take on more analytical work, they need dependable access to telemetry and context: which service an entity belongs to, what it depends on, who owns it, and what changed. This role owns the shared platform capabilities that make that possible across observability, security, and platform optimization.

You will own established search and analytics capabilities while building toward federated analytics and a richer customer context foundation. This is a technically deep role requiring first-hand experience with data platforms, search, or analytics products, and the judgment to turn a broad platform vision into useful capabilities that teams can adopt.

**What You Will Own**

**The search and query platform.** Search and query capabilities, query language and analytical functions, partitions, views, and shared query services. You will own their roadmap, performance, reliability, and competitiveness, balancing analytical depth, ease of use, and cost for both human and agent workloads.

**Federated analytics.** Define how customers and agents query and correlate Sumo data with data in connected systems. Establish the use cases, supported analytical capabilities, and tradeoffs around data movement, freshness, performance, permissions, and cost, working closely with the teams responsible for integrations and access.

**Customer context and the knowledge graph.** Build the shared understanding of a customer's environment: entities, services, workloads, ownership, topology, and dependencies. Define how that context is assembled from telemetry, metadata, and connected systems, how relationships are maintained, and how the accumulated context improves investigation and analysis over time.

**Data discovery and shared context services.** Help people and agents discover available sources, schemas, fields, and relationships, and retrieve the data and context relevant to a task. Own the shared capabilities that make this information reusable across product experiences, with clear provenance, freshness, and permission boundaries.

**What You Will Be Doing**

* Set the multi-quarter vision and roadmap for the data and analytics platform, connecting current customer needs with the requirements of AI-assisted investigation.
* Own the health and evolution of shipping query capabilities, partitions, and views, using customer feedback and workload data to prioritize improvements.
* Work with engineering and architecture on query execution, distributed analytics, scalability, and cost at enterprise scale.
* Define and validate federated analytics use cases, and turn them into phased capabilities with clear behavior and limits.
* Develop the entity and context strategy, including how services and resources are identified consistently across data sources and related to one another.
* Partner with investigation, security, knowledge, and agent teams to turn their needs into shared platform capabilities and clear interfaces.
* Partner with the product and engineering teams responsible for platform governance to ensure query and context capabilities respect established access controls, audit requirements, and cost policies.
* Translate strategy into clear proposals, PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and rollout plans.
* Measure query success, latency, reliability, cost, context quality, and adoption, and show how platform improvements improve customer outcomes.

**What You Bring**

* 6+ years of product management experience, including direct ownership of data platforms, search, query systems, or analytics products. Relevant platform experience is a hard requirement.
* Strong technical understanding of query processing, data organization, indexing, schemas, and distributed systems, with depth in one or more of these areas.
* Experience running a live product at scale, balancing customer commitments, performance, reliability, and cost while delivering a longer-term roadmap.
* Experience building shared platform capabilities, APIs, or services used by multiple product teams or external developers.
* The ability to reason about analytical correctness, incomplete data, data freshness, and the limits of what a system can reliably infer.
* Familiarity with federated analytics, metadata platforms, entity resolution, knowledge graphs, or retrieval systems. Experience in one or more of these areas is valuable.
* An understanding of how AI agents discover data, use tools, and retrieve context, or the ability to ramp quickly. Observability or security analytics experience is a plus.
* Strong analytical skills and comfort using SQL, dashboards, and usage data to understand customer behavior and evaluate tradeoffs.
* Clear communication across technical and business audiences, and the ability to write proposals that explain options, dependencies, and recommendations.

**Must Have Qualities**

* **Platform judgment.** Finds common needs across teams and turns them into capabilities others can depend on.
* **Customer grounding.** Connects technical investment to a concrete improvement in analysis, investigation, or cost.
* **Data correctness and trust.** Treats accuracy, consistency, provenance, and freshness as product requirements.
* **Runs today and builds tomorrow.** Keeps current capabilities healthy while delivering the next generation of the platform.
* **High ownership.** Resolves ambiguity, makes tradeoffs explicit, and drives work through delivery and adoption.

**About Us**
------------

Sumo Logic, Inc. helps make the digital world secure, fast, and reliable by unifying critical security and operational data through its Intelligent Operations Platform. Built to address the increasing complexity of modern cybersecurity and cloud operations challenges, we empower digital teams to move from reaction to readiness—combining agentic AI-powered SIEM and log analytics into a single platform to detect, investigate, and resolve modern challenges. Customers around the world rely on Sumo Logic for trusted insights to protect against security threats, ensure reliability, and gain powerful insights into their digital environments. For more information, visit www.sumologic.com.

Sumo Logic Privacy Policy. Employees will be responsible for complying with applicable federal privacy laws and regulations, as well as organizational policies related to data protection.

With AI at its core and operating at unparalleled scale, Sabre transforms insights into innovation, empowering airlines, hoteliers, agencies and other partners to retail, distribute and fulfill travel worldwide.

Team Description
  
  
We are seeking a **Senior Product Manager** to join our Digital Experience team. The team owns and scales whitelabel e-commerce and post-booking servicing products for leading global airline partners, connecting complex airline and retailing capabilities with modern digital experiences to deliver seamless traveler journeys.

  

As a Senior Product Manager, you will help drive the roadmap and execution of our **Digital Experience (DX)** product across SabreSonic and SabreMosaic platforms. You will work closely with engineering, architecture, delivery, commercial teams and global airline customers to translate business and customer needs into scalable product capabilities.

  

The role combines product strategy with hands-on execution. You will manage roadmap priorities and customer requirements, guide agile backlogs, partner with technical teams on solution direction, and help evolve our products as the airline industry transitions toward modern Offer & Order retailing.
  
  
**What you'll do**

* Own and evolve product roadmaps for Digital Experience capabilities across SabreSonic and SabreMosaic, balancing strategic roadmap priorities, customer commitments and platform modernization.
* Manage product requirements and priorities for DX and DXCI, including customer change requests, roadmap initiatives and ongoing product enhancements.
* Translate customer and business needs into clearly defined product requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria for agile engineering teams.
* Partner closely with engineering and architecture teams to evaluate solution options, understand technical trade-offs and deliver scalable product capabilities.
* Work directly with global airline customers, delivery teams and commercial stakeholders to understand requirements, identify product gaps and shape product priorities.
* Support the evolution of digital experiences as airline customers transition from traditional PNR-based workflows toward Offer & Order retailing.
* Analyze product issues, customer escalations and maintenance requirements in partnership with engineering and delivery teams, helping determine appropriate product solutions.
* Use customer feedback, product data, industry trends and operational insights to inform prioritization and product decisions.
* Deliver product demonstrations, roadmap discussions and capability presentations to internal stakeholders and global airline customers.
Coordinate across multiple parallel initiatives and customer commitments while maintaining clear prioritization and product direction.  

Qualifications and Education Requirements:

* 5+ years of product management or closely related experience, preferably working with complex enterprise software, e-commerce platforms or high-scale digital products.
* Demonstrated experience owning product capabilities through the full lifecycle, from requirements and prioritization through development, release and ongoing evolution.
* Experience working directly with engineering teams in an Agile/Scrum software development environment, including backlog management, story refinement and acceptance criteria.
* Strong technical aptitude and the ability to understand how APIs, backend services, platform capabilities and frontend experiences work together.
* Experience engaging directly with customers or partners to understand needs, define requirements and translate them into scalable product capabilities.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess competing requirements and make informed prioritization decisions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex product and technical concepts to both technical and business audiences.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple initiatives and customer priorities simultaneously in a global environment.

We will give careful consideration to your application and review your details against the position criteria. You will receive separate notification as your application progresses.

Please note that only candidates who meet the minimum criteria for the role will proceed in the selection process.

title: Senior Product Manager I
description:
About Us:

Seismic is the Go-To-Market Performance company, driving how organizations turn their strategy into revenue. Seismic brings together signals from customer conversations, buyer engagement, governed content, coaching and seller behavior to turn intelligence into winning action. Through its AI revenue execution platform, the company equips customer-facing teams with the insights, governance, and contextual guidance they need to execute with confidence and deliver measurable business outcomes. Trusted by 2,500 organizations and over 3.5 million users around the globe, Seismic is headquartered in San Diego with offices across North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. Learn more at seismic.com.

Seismic is committed to building an inclusive workplace that ignites growth for our employees and creates a culture of belonging that allows all employees to be seen and valued for who they are. Learn more about DEI at Seismic here.

Overview:

Learning is where that mission gets personal. Our vision is Connected Learning: training, practice, and coaching that are always-on and tailored to each rep, grounded in what's actually happening in their deals. Because learning shares context with a rep's accounts, meetings, approved content, and skills, we can deliver what they need next, in the moment they need it, and show whether it moved the number.

As a Senior Product Manager, you'll lead key parts of two of our strategic themes: Adaptive Training, which removes the manual work for enablement teams and gives every rep only what they still need, and Continuous Learning, which brings learning into the flow of work so it sticks. You'll partner closely with others PMs on the team.

At Seismic, PMs operate as the general managers of their areas. You won't be handed a backlog of feature requests. You'll decide where the most valuable, durable opportunities are, place the bets, and own the results: adoption, expansion, retention, and revenue. This is a role for a PM who wants to run a business, not maintain a feature list.

Who you are::

* **5+ years of product management experience** building user-facing products (B2B or B2C). You're fluent in discovery, specs, prioritization, and launch, and you don't need training on the fundamentals.
* **An AI-forward way of working**. You use AI every day to work faster and better, whether that's synthesizing research, prototyping, drafting specs, or analyzing data, and you can share specific recent examples.
* **A business owner's mindset**. You think in terms of outcomes, unit economics, and durable value, define clear success metrics, read the data, and change course when the evidence says so.
* **Technical fluency**. You can have credible conversations with engineers about LLMs, agent harness, data, and design tradeoffs.
* **A strong point of view**, held with humility. You can turn ambiguity into a clear plan and bring engineering, design, marketing, sales, and customer success along with you.
* Comfort working with distributed teams across time zones, including occasional early or late meetings.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

**Bonus points**

* You've shipped AI products, such as agents, copilots, or AI-powered features, and know what it takes to make them reliable.
* You've built learning products, in corporate learning, sales enablement and readiness, edtech, or consumer learning.
* You're curious about how people learn: spaced reinforcement, mastery learning, coaching, and practice.
* A category being rewritten. AI is changing how sellers learn and how enablement teams work, and you'll help define what comes next.
* Ownership that's real. You'll run a meaningful area of the business, with the accountability and the room to match.
* Real scale from day one. Your work will reach enablement teams and sellers at some of the world's best-known brands.
* A team that builds with AI, not just for it. We use agentic tools in our own work and expect you to as well.

What you'll be doing::

* Run your areas like a business. Set the strategy and roadmap, choose the bets that create the most durable value, help shape how they're packaged and priced, and own the adoption, retention, and revenue outcomes that follow.
* Create best-in-class agentic training authoring and training management, so enablement teams turn the content they already trust into training in minutes and agents handle the busywork of assigning, tracking, and following up, whether teams work in Seismic or in the AI tools they already use.
* Make training adapt to every rep, so reps skip what they've already mastered and spend their time on what they still need.
* Bring learning into the flow of work with just-in-time micro-learning, instant answers grounded in training, and peer examples from top performers' real calls.
* Connect learning to performance. Use deal, meeting, and skill signals to decide what each rep needs next, and define how we prove impact beyond course completions.
* Stay close to customers. Talk with enablement leaders, sellers, and managers every week, run discovery with design and research, and bring a sharp point of view back to the team.
* Ship with engineering in fast, measurable increments, including the evals and quality bar that make AI features trustworthy.

At Bazaarvoice, we create smart shopping experiences. Through our expansive global network, product-passionate community & enterprise technology, we connect thousands of brands and retailers with billions of consumers. The result is smarter shopping: loyal customers, increased sales, and improved products.

The problem we are trying to solve : Brands and retailers struggle to make real connections with consumers. It's a challenge to deliver trustworthy and inspiring content in the moments that matter most during the discovery and purchase cycle. The result? Time and money spent on content that doesn't attract new consumers, convert them, or earn their long-term loyalty.

Our brand promise : closing the gap between brands and consumers.

It’s official: Bazaarvoice is a Great Place to Work in the US , Australia, India, Lithuania, France, Germany and the UK!

Influenster is the product-passionate member community at the heart of Bazaarvoice’s Consumer Acquisition & Sampling (CAS) business. Members discover products, try samples, and share honest reviews that power brand campaigns. The CAS Fundamentals team owns the core member experience that keeps this community healthy: onboarding, identity, trust, discovery, and the everyday reasons members come back.

As the Senior Product Manager for CAS Fundamentals, you will keep members happy, engaged, and coming back to Influenster. * Define the strategy and a 1–2 year roadmap for the Influenster member experience, with clear ownership of the CAS Fundamentals KPIs:

* Experience building and scaling mobile apps in a D2C setting (helpful)

* Strong ownership of engagement metrics (MAU, retention, activation) and the ability to design and analyze experiments to move them.

* Comfort with data: you define success metrics, run analyses, and use product analytics tools to make decisions.
* Ability to prioritize across competing goals and communicate trade-offs clearly to stakeholders and senior leadership.
* Adaptable and comfortable with ambiguity in a multi-sided environment serving members, brands, and retailers.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with a track record of working closely with engineering and design.

description:
**Senior Product Manager**

**Response Automation (SIEM and SOAR)**

Sumo Logic is hiring a Senior Product Manager to own the automation foundations that help security teams and AI agents turn detections into fast, safe, consistent response.

Finding a threat is half the job. Analysts still spend too much time enriching alerts, chasing context, opening tickets, and running containment steps by hand. As AI agents take on more of that work, response automation has to be dependable, auditable, and easy to control. This role owns the playbook, orchestration, and case management capabilities across Cloud SIEM and Cloud SOAR that make that possible.

You will own established automation capabilities while building toward agent-driven response and a tighter SIEM-to-SOAR experience. This is a technically deep role. It requires first-hand experience with security operations, SOAR, or workflow automation products, and the judgment to turn a broad platform vision into capabilities that SOC teams adopt and trust.

**What You Will Own**

**Playbooks and the automation engine.** The playbook editor, triggers, actions, execution engine, and the Automation Service. You will own their roadmap, performance, reliability, and competitiveness, balancing power, ease of use, and cost for analysts, detection engineers, and agents.

**Cloud SIEM and Cloud SOAR together.** Define how insights and signals in Cloud SIEM trigger automations and hand off to Cloud SOAR for incident and case management. Establish where the Automation Service ends and full Cloud SOAR begins, with clear packaging, upgrade paths, and one coherent customer experience.

**Integrations, actions, and App Central.** Set the strategy for enrichment, notification, containment, user choice, and custom actions. Prioritize integrations across endpoint, identity, cloud, ticketing, threat intelligence, and messaging tools. Own coverage, quality, and lifecycle for out-of-the-box playbooks and integrations.

**Agentic and human-in-the-loop response.** Define how AI agents discover, invoke, and chain playbooks and actions. Establish the approval steps, scoped permissions, guardrails, and audit trails that let customers decide which responses run automatically and which need an analyst's sign-off.

  

**What You Will Be Doing**

* Set the multi-quarter vision and roadmap for response automation, connecting current SOC needs with the requirements of AI-assisted investigation and response.
* Own the health and evolution of shipping playbook, automation, and case management capabilities, using customer feedback and execution data to prioritize improvements.
* Work with engineering and architecture on execution reliability, scalability, error handling, and cost at enterprise scale.
* Define and validate response use cases, such as phishing, compromised identity, and endpoint containment, and turn them into phased capabilities with clear behavior and limits.
* Develop the integration and action strategy, including how actions are named, scoped, versioned, and made safe to run without a person watching.
* Partner with detection, investigation, knowledge, and agent teams to turn their needs into shared automation capabilities and clear interfaces.
* Partner with the product and engineering teams responsible for platform governance to ensure automation respects established access controls, audit requirements, and cost policies.
* Translate strategy into clear proposals, PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and rollout plans.
* Measure playbook success rate, time to respond, analyst time saved, reliability, cost, and adoption, and show how automation improvements lead to better security outcomes.

**What You Bring**

* 6+ years of product management experience, including direct ownership of security operations, SOAR, SIEM, or workflow automation products. Relevant platform experience is a hard requirement.
* Strong technical understanding of incident response workflows, orchestration engines, event-driven systems, APIs, and the integrations that connect security tools.
* Experience running a live product at scale, balancing customer commitments, reliability, and cost while delivering a longer-term roadmap.
* Experience building shared platform capabilities, APIs, or services used by multiple product teams, partners, or external developers.
* The ability to reason about automation risk, including false positives, partial failures, and the point where a human should approve an action.
* Familiarity with SOC operations and frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK and the NIST incident response lifecycle. Experience with case management, threat intelligence, or integration marketplaces is valuable.
* An understanding of how AI agents discover tools, take actions, and operate within guardrails, or the ability to ramp quickly. Hands-on SOC or security engineering experience is a plus.
* Strong analytical skills and comfort using SQL, dashboards, and usage data to understand customer behavior and evaluate tradeoffs.
* Clear communication across technical and business audiences, and the ability to write proposals that explain options, dependencies, and recommendations.

**Must Have Qualities**

* **Platform judgment.** Finds common needs across teams and turns them into capabilities others can depend on.
* **Customer grounding.** Connects technical investment to a concrete improvement in response time, analyst workload, or risk reduction.
* **Safety and trust.** Treats control, auditability, and predictable behavior as product requirements, especially when automation takes action on its own.
* **Runs today and builds tomorrow.** Keeps current capabilities healthy while delivering the next generation of the platform.
* **High ownership.** Resolves ambiguity, makes tradeoffs explicit, and drives work through delivery and adoption.

**About Us**
------------

Sumo Logic, Inc. helps make the digital world secure, fast, and reliable by unifying critical security and operational data through its Intelligent Operations Platform. Built to address the increasing complexity of modern cybersecurity and cloud operations challenges, we empower digital teams to move from reaction to readiness—combining agentic AI-powered SIEM and log analytics into a single platform to detect, investigate, and resolve modern challenges. Customers around the world rely on Sumo Logic for trusted insights to protect against security threats, ensure reliability, and gain powerful insights into their digital environments. For more information, visit www.sumologic.com.
