**Job Summary**
---------------

* Own the Cash product agenda across the Digital channels, with strategic accountability for translating Cash and Payments priorities into scalable capabilities across Host-to-Host (H2H), SWIFT and Common Channel Services (CCS).

• Lead the development, prioritisation and commercialisation of channel capabilities and features, ensuring investment is anchored in clear client use cases, measurable commercial value, regulatory needs and end-to-end client outcomes.
  
• Lead and develop a team of Product Owners to convert strategy into an executable global roadmap and deliver consistent, secure and reusable Cash Digital capabilities across markets, client segments and connectivity models.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Strategy, portfolio and business partnership**  
• Own the global Cash channel strategy and roadmap across Web, H2H, SWIFT and CCS, aligning country, regional and global demand to business priorities.
  
• Act as the senior Channels counterpart to Cash Product heads and represent the portfolio in senior governance, investment and prioritisation forums.
  
• Partner with global, regional and country Cash Product heads to understand business, client and product priorities in every market.
  
• Manage senior stakeholders across global product and country management, Channels and Technology, setting expectations on scope, timing and trade-offs. Make transparent trade-offs across growth, client commitments, regulatory or scheme deadlines, resilience, simplification and platform modernisation.
  
**Product execution and prioritisation**  
• Own the global Cash backlog for Channels and rank demand using commercial value, client impact, regulatory urgency, risk, effort and delivery feasibility.
  
• Lead the working relationship between Cash, country, Channel Product and Technology teams to agree scope, dependencies, release plans and accountable outcomes.
  
• Run one intake process for all demand, sorting each request, assess client requests tied to mandates /RFPs and implementation deadlines, track regulatory requirements against deadlines.
  
• Apply a clear prioritisation framework, ringfence capacity across regulatory, client driven scope on revenue and client priority, and sequence delivery. Spot common needs across markets to deliver them as global capabilities.
  
• Maintain executive oversight of multiple initiatives running in parallel across markets, products and channels, keep a portfolio view of status, risks, milestones and cross-channel dependencies, intervening early where delivery or value is at risk.
  
**Client insight, proposition and commercialisation**  
• Build evidence-based country and client use cases covering target segments, revenue and volumes at stake, adoption barriers, competitive gaps and the cost of not acting.
  
• Define differentiated value propositions and commercialisation plans for new capabilities, partnering with Sales, Implementation, Onboarding and Client Service to drive launch readiness and adoption.
  
• Track adoption, transaction volumes, client feedback and realised benefits after launch, using insights to refine the proposition and roadmap.

**Cross-channel capability and solution leadership**  
**• Translate Cash and Payments needs into end-to-end capabilities spanning digital journeys, entitlements, approvals, connectivity, formats, payment status and reporting.**  
**• Guide solutioning across H2H connectivity (SFTP, AS2 and HTTPS), SWIFT channels (FileAct, FIN and gpi), ISO 20022 messages and legacy or local clearing formats.**  
**• Promote reusable components, standard formats and common services while safeguarding security, resilience, sanctions, fraud, accessibility and regulatory requirements.**  
**People and talent**  
**• Lead, coach and develop Product Owners, translating strategy into clear objectives and allocating capacity to the highest-value work.**  
**• Build strategic, commercial, client and channel depth across the team, strengthening prioritisation, stakeholder management, product discipline and succession capacity.**  
**• Role-model the Bank’s valued behaviours, sound risk judgement, constructive feedback, inclusion, wellbeing and accountability.**  
**Risk, controls and governance**  
**• Embed product, operational, information security, regulatory and conduct requirements throughout discovery, design, delivery, release and post-launch review.**  
**• Ensure material decisions, exceptions, residual risks and control dependencies are appropriately governed and documented.**  
**• Maintain accurate client-facing specifications, user guidance, release notes, testing support and migration plans for new or changed capabilities.**

**Skills and Experience**
-------------------------

**Must-have Skills**  
**• Cash and Payments Product Strategy**  
**• Digital Channels and Corporate Connectivity**  
**• Product Commercialisation and Value Proposition**  
**Other Skills**  
**• Portfolio Prioritisation and Investment Discipline**  
**• Client and Market Insight**  
**• Senior Stakeholder Influence**  
**• People Leadership and Product Team Development**

**Motivations**
---------------

* **Shaping client-channel strategy and turning complex Cash and Payments needs into scalable propositions with visible commercial and client value.**

**• Leading across business, product and technology boundaries to resolve competing priorities and deliver high-impact outcomes across markets.**  
**• Building empowered Product Owner teams that combine deep channel expertise with strategic thinking, disciplined execution and strong client focus.**

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Key Experiences**  
**• 15+ years of senior-level experience in Transaction Banking, Cash Management, Payments or enterprise digital channels, including product strategy, proposition development, commercialisation and execution.**  
**• Deep experience in corporate connectivity and more than one client channel, with working knowledge of H2H, SWIFT, APIs and corporate Web banking.**  
**• Strong Cash and Payments domain understanding across domestic and cross-border payments, real-time and bulk payments, payroll, receivables, liquidity, statements and reporting.**  
**• Working command of ISO 20022 payment and reporting messages, legacy MT formats, local clearing formats, and ERP or treasury management system integration.**  
**• Demonstrated experience building business cases, prioritising investments and managing multiple initiatives across countries, products and channels.**  
**• Strong experience in Portfolio management at scale, running a large backlog with many initiatives in parallel, while sharing limited delivery capacity across countries and demand types.**  
**• Proven leadership of Product Owners or Product Managers and senior-level influence across Product, Sales, Technology, Operations, Risk and Compliance.**  
**Certifications / Qualifications (only where mandatory):** **Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience in business, finance, engineering, computer science or a related discipline. No role-specific certification is mandatory.**  
**Languages:** **English: professional fluency. Additional languages are advantageous where relevant to the role’s market coverage.**

**About Standard Chartered**
----------------------------

**We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.**

**Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.**

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* **Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation** **, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.**
* **In line with our Fair Pay Charter** **, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.**
* **Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance** **, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.**
* **Time-off** **including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.**
* **Flexible working** **options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.**
* **Proactive wellbeing support** **through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.**
* **A continuous learning culture** **to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.**

**Company Description**

The Nemetschek Group is a leading global vertical software and AI provider driving the digital transformation of the AEC/O and media industries. With our deep domain expertise and intelligent, connected software solutions, we enable customers to turn data into real-time insights and smarter decisions throughout the entire lifecycle of buildings and infrastructure from ideation through planning, visualization, construction, operation, and renovation.  
Our AI-powered technologies and open standards approach boost productivity, collaboration, and sustainability for architects, engineers, contractors, building operators, and creative professionals. Over 7 million users worldwide rely on our customer-centric, human-led AI solutions. Founded by Professor Georg Nemetschek in 1963, today we employ over 4,000 experts globally across 14 subsidiaries.

 **Job Description**

What we are looking for

We are hiring a **Product Manager for SDS2** who combines strong product-management fundamentals with practical understanding of **structural steel fabrication, detailing, or manufacturing**. This is not intended to be a general-purpose software PM role.

The ideal candidate understands how engineering software fits into real fabrication workflows and has an **AI-first mindset**, actively looking for ways AI can improve detailing, automation, decision-making, user productivity, and the way we build products.

Industry & Technical Background

* Strong experience with **structural steel fabrication, steel detailing, manufacturing, or closely related industrial engineering workflows**
* Ability to communicate credibly with detailers, fabricators, engineers, developers, and customers
* Bachelor's degree in **engineering, architecture, or a closely related technical field**
* Understanding of complex engineering/manufacturing workflows and the ability to translate them into software requirements

Product Management

* Ideally **5+ years of Product Management / Product Ownership experience**, preferably with AEC, engineering, manufacturing, or technical B2B software
* Demonstrated ownership of:
  + Product vision and roadmap
  + Customer discovery and requirements
  + Epics and backlog prioritization
  + Agile product development
  + Product lifecycle
  + Market and competitive analysis
  + Product launches / GTM
  + Product metrics and business outcomes
* Strong project-management capability across distributed, cross-functional teams
* Excellent written, verbal, and customer-facing communication skills
* Comfortable working directly with Engineering, UX, Sales, Support, Marketing, customers, and senior leadership.
* **Jira** for requirements, epics, backlog, and Agile development
* **Basecamp** for project/program coordination
* Customer-facing product discovery
* Structural engineering knowledge
* Fabrication shop experience
* BIM / digital fabrication workflows
* APIs, interoperability, or integrations
* Enterprise B2B software experience
* Data-driven product management

AI-First Mindset

We want someone who views **AI as a fundamental part of the future of SDS2**, not simply another feature.

Look for candidates who:

* Routinely use AI tools in their own work
* Understand practical applications of **AI/ML, copilots, agents, automation, or intelligent workflows**
* Can identify repetitive or knowledge-intensive detailing tasks that could be automated or augmented
* Can translate AI opportunities into customer problems, workflows, requirements, and measurable outcomes
* Are curious and willing to experiment rather than waiting for established industry solutions

Direct AI product experience is highly desirable but should **not outweigh steel-industry/domain knowledge**.

Strong Differentiators

Experience with one or more of the following should move a candidate **significantly higher in the recruiting funnel**:

**Steel / Detailing Software**

* SDS2
* Tekla Structures
* Advance Steel
* Bocad
* ProSteel

**Engineering / Manufacturing Software**

description:
At Boeing, we innovate and collaborate to make the world a better place. We’re committed to fostering an environment for every teammate that’s welcoming, respectful and inclusive, with great opportunity for professional growth. Find your future with us.

**Overview**

Boeing is the world's largest aerospace company and leading manufacturer of commercial airplanes and defense, space and security systems. We are engineers and technicians. Skilled scientists and thinkers. Bold innovators and dreamers. Join us, and you can build something better for yourself, for our customers and for the world.

As a leading global aerospace company, Boeing develops, manufactures and services commercial airplanes, defense products and space systems for customers in more than 150 countries. As a top U.S. exporter, the company leverages the talents of a global supplier base to advance economic opportunity, sustainability and community impact. Boeing’s team is committed to innovating for the future, leading with sustainability, and cultivating a culture based on the company’s core values of safety, quality and integrity.

**Technology for today and tomorrow**

The Boeing India Engineering & Technology Center (BIETC) is a 5500+ engineering workforce that contributes to global aerospace growth. Our engineers deliver cutting-edge R&D, innovation, and high-quality engineering work in global markets, and leverage new-age technologies such as AI/ML, IIoT, Cloud, Model-Based Engineering, and Additive Manufacturing, shaping the future of aerospace.

**People-driven culture**

At Boeing, we believe creativity and innovation thrives when every employee is trusted, empowered, and has the flexibility to choose, grow, learn, and explore. We offer variable arrangements depending upon business and customer needs, and professional pursuits that offer greater flexibility in the way our people work. We also believe that collaboration, frequent team engagements, and face-to-face meetings bring together different perspectives and thoughts – enabling every voice to be heard and every perspective to be respected. No matter where or how our teammates work, we are committed to positively shaping people’s careers and being thoughtful about employee wellbeing.

With us, you can create and contribute to what matters most in your career, community, country, and world. Join us in powering the progress of global aerospace.

**Position Overview:**

**Boeing Digital Services org** is currently looking for a **Senior Lead Product Owner** to join the team in **Bangalore, IN.** In this role you will drive product ownership excellence across a portfolio of maintenance and flight product suits. You will establish and scale product management practices, processes, standards, and governance across the organization while providing strategic direction and coaching to Product Owners and Development teams. You will serve as a trusted advisor to product, engineering, business, technology, and executive stakeholders. You will influence outcomes across multiple teams and products without direct authority and ensure that product decisions are driven by customer value, business impact, data, risk, and delivery feasibility.

The role combines enterprise-level Product Owner responsibilities with selected Product Manager responsibilities, including portfolio strategy, market analysis, product positioning, investment planning, customer discovery, business case development, and product lifecycle management. You will work closely with Developers, Product Owners, Greenfield Leadership, Data Scientists, and Architects to deliver product features and capabilities that keep AI and ML at the center of our solutions. You will be helping create new product offerings as well as modernizing systems that have been running the business for years, while building new ones designed to run it for years to come.

**Position Responsibilities:**

* Define and communicate portfolio-level product vision, strategy, objectives, outcomes, and roadmaps for aviation / MRO products, platforms, and capabilities.

* Evaluate customer needs, market trends, competitive offerings, emerging technologies, and internal capabilities to identify opportunities for new products, enhancements, modernization, consolidation, or retirement.

* Establish and maintain consistent product management and product ownership practices, processes, standards, governance, templates, and decision-making frameworks across the organization.

* Provide strategic direction, mentoring, and coaching to Product Owners, Product Managers, and Business Analysts in product discovery, prioritization, backlog management, stakeholder engagement, and value delivery.

* Guide teams in translating customer and business needs into well-defined epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, non-functional requirements, and measurable outcomes.

* Lead portfolio-level prioritization and resolve cross-product dependencies, competing demands, sequencing decisions, resource constraints, and delivery trade-offs.

* Partner with customers and stakeholders to validate product concepts, business problems, solution alternatives, priorities, prototypes, and early product definitions.

* Define and monitor product and portfolio success measures, including customer satisfaction, adoption, operational performance, financial value, quality, delivery, and business outcomes.

* Represent the customer and business perspective throughout product development, Agile delivery, Program Increment planning, release planning, system demonstrations, and operational readiness activities.

* Partner with engineering, architecture, security, quality, operations, and support teams to evaluate technical options, integrations, scalability, technical debt, maintainability, resilience, and non-functional requirements.

* Communicate portfolio priorities, roadmap changes, investment recommendations, delivery progress, performance results, risks, and decisions to customers, stakeholders, and senior leadership while driving continuous improvement in product management maturity and value delivery.

**Basic Qualifications (Required Skills/Experience):**

* Bachelor’s degree is required as basic qualification.
* 15+ years relevant experience in software development including full-stack web development, experience with modern software product development, integration, and delivery

* Experience integrating AI, ML, or LLM capabilities into software applications.

* Familiarity with AI-enabled product management tools and responsible use of generative AI for analysis, documentation, research, and decision support.

* Significant experience in Product Ownership, Product Management, business analysis, solution management, or a related discipline, including experience leading across multiple products.

* Extensive experience working in Agile and Scrum environments, including experience with SAFe, Lean Portfolio Management, Program Increment planning, and Product Owner/Product Manager responsibilities.

* Experience developing and implementing product management practices, operating models, governance frameworks, and standard processes across multiple teams or product areas.

* Demonstrated ability to coach and guide Product Owners and Product Managers in product discovery, prioritization, backlog management, stakeholder engagement, and value delivery.

* Familiarity with latest tools & technology frameworks like JavaScript, JQuery, Java/J2EE, Azure App Services / Functions, Microservices etc.

* Experience with DevOps practices, including CI/CD, Configuration management, Automated testing, Monitoring and observability, Metrics and telemetry, and Infrastructure as code

* Experience with Microsoft Azure services and Azure DevOps.

* Experience with APIs, event-driven integrations, data platforms, analytics, and cloud-native architectures.

* Familiarity with Angular, React, React Native, or comparable web and mobile technologies.

* Understanding of mobile user experience principles and platform-specific design guidelines.

* Understanding of architectural styles like microservices, event-driven systems, monoliths, and serverless computing.

**Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills/Experience):**

* Experience in Aerospace and/or Aviation and/or MRO domain is preferred

* Product management or Agile certifications such as: Certified Scrum Product Owner, SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager, SAFe Product Management

* Experience leading product management transformation, product operating model implementation, or Agile-at-scale adoption.

* Experience managing enterprise platforms, digital products, software ecosystems, or products involving complex integrations.

* Demonstrated ability to collaborate across Product, Design, Engineering, and Operations to translate ambiguous business needs into clear technical solutions and measurable outcomes.

* Demonstrated ability to coach and uplift other engineers through pairing, code review, technical mentorship, and knowledge sharing.

**Typical Education & Experience:**

* Education/experience typically acquired through advanced education (e.g. Bachelor) and typically 16 + years’ related work experience or an equivalent combination of education and experience (e.g. Master 15+ Years ) related in computer science, aerospace or other closely related field.

description:

Job Description:

As a Sr. Product Manager for Marketing Technology, you are responsible for the ideation, development, launch, and optimization of the internal platforms that power how Ingram Micro plans, sells, executes, and bills for marketing programs with our vendor and channel partners. You have a deep understanding of marketing operations and marketing-centric order-to-cash processes, from program planning, scoping, and approvals through contracting, execution, proof of performance, claiming, invoicing, and revenue recognition. You bring a “build to replace what we buy” mindset: studying how work gets done today across people, processes, and purchased tools, identifying where fragmented or costly systems slow us down, and building more efficient, integrated solutions that shorten time to value and reduce total cost of ownership. You will partner closely with engineering, architecture, finance, and marketing operations teams to retire legacy tools, consolidate workflows, and lay the data and integration foundations for automation and AI-driven orchestration. A successful candidate will demonstrate the ability to clearly define a problem statement, build a fact-based business case, deliver a product vision, prioritize initiatives informed by data, drive execution, and champion the change management adoption plans with our partners.

The Sr. Product Manager, Marketing Technology for Ingram Micro’s Global Platform Team will be a key leader on the Marketing Engine Team. They will be responsible for:

* Setting a product vision and strategy that aligns with company, organization, and team level objectives.
* Developing and executing the product roadmap for marketing technology. This includes replacing legacy and third-party tools with internally built capabilities, and integrating with enterprise ERP, finance, work management, and content systems.
* Studying current operational and technological ways of working – mapping processes, hand-offs, systems, and costs – to identify where consolidation, automation, or a build-versus-buy decision will save time and money.
* Building the business case for build-versus-buy decisions, weighing license and contract costs, operational effort, security and compliance risk, and time to value.
* Owning end-to-end marketing order-to-cash workflows and partnering with finance and accounting to ensure marketing requirements for billing, invoicing, claims, and revenue recognition are represented in enterprise programs.
* Leading collaboration across UX, Engineering, Data, and Business teams, and serving as SME to the global marketing and finance community to validate that features solve their business and partner needs and are easy to understand.
* Leading migration and decommissioning plans for replaced systems, including data migration, UAT, pilot rollouts, and country-by-country change management.
* Owning the excellence of your product(s) - be scrappy, solve problems, and take an entrepreneurial approach to deliver against business outcomes.
Defining, monitoring, and analyzing product and business metrics such as cycle time, manual effort removed, cost avoided, and adoption, and feeding learnings back into the product development process.  

What you bring to the role:

* Bachelor's degree in business administration, engineering, science, and a related technical emphasis is required. Preferred: an MBA (or equivalent) from a top-tier institution, or equivalent business experience.
* 5-8 years of product management experience, ideally leading internal platform, business systems, or marketing technology products.
* Familiarity with marketing-centric order-to-cash processes, systems, use cases, and complexities, such as partner marketing funds, program scoping and approvals, contracts, proof of performance, claims, and invoicing.
* Demonstrated experience assessing current-state operations and technology, and delivering systems that replaced purchased or legacy tools while reducing cost and time to value.
* Working knowledge of enterprise integration patterns (APIs, ERP, workflow and rules engines) and the ability to discuss architecture tradeoffs with engineering.
* Experience working with go-to-market, marketing operations, and finance teams to drive adoption of products across partners & internal associates.
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to derive meaningful insights from complex data sets.
* Exceptional cross-functional collaboration skills and ability to influence without authority.
* Understanding and experience in compliance with data privacy, security, and financial controls requirements.
* Direct hands-on experience working with Engineering teams to clearly scope, define, detail, and prioritize product requirements and maintain a well-groomed backlog.
* Experience developing and launching successful software products.
* Outstanding communication and presentation skills (verbal and written). Should be comfortable presenting to executive staff, key stakeholders, and large teams.
* Passion for quality and commitment to creating efficient, intuitive experiences that remove manual work.
* Ability to work with remote partners and team members via online tools across different time zones.
* Position may require occasional travel, including international travel.

**About Broadridge:**
---------------------

Broadridge Financial Solutions is a global fintech leader providing technology, communications and data-driven solutions that power the financial services industry. The **Finance Data Product Lead – Data & Analytics** owns the design and support of data products, interfaces and processes in the Finance data ecosystem, spanning upstream systems (ERP and homegrown), the enterprise data platform, and consuming application integration.

This role is accountable for defining, supporting and governing scalable data products and processes, ensuring data integrity and reliability at enterprise scale, and acting as a trusted speaking partner to IT, Finance, and external service providers.

**Team Overview**

The Product TPM team operates at the intersection of business, technology, and delivery, enabling the successful development and rollout of scalable, customer-centric solutions. At the Consultant (P03) level, the team is composed of Technical Product Managers who own feature-level delivery while collaborating closely with engineering, design, and business stakeholders.
  
The team functions within an Agile framework, ensuring continuous delivery of high-quality product increments through iterative development, sprint cycles, and regular feedback loops. Each TPM is responsible for managing specific product modules or features, contributing to the broader product roadmap while aligning execution with organizational goals and customer needs.

This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week.  
  

**Role Overview And Core Responsibilities**

The Consultant (P03) – Technical Product Management (TPM) role is responsible for driving the end-to-end delivery of technology-enabled product features by effectively bridging business requirements with engineering execution. The role combines product ownership, technical understanding, and Agile delivery to ensure the development of scalable, high-quality solutions aligned with customer needs and organizational priorities.

At this level, the TPM owns feature-level execution, collaborates closely with cross-functional teams, and contributes to product strategy and roadmap under guidance from senior product leaders.
  
  
Role Overview And Core Responsibilities

**1. Product Ownership**

* Own and manage assigned product features or modules from concept to delivery
* Define detailed user stories, acceptance criteria, and maintain the product backlog
* Prioritize deliverables based on business value, customer impact, and feasibility

**2. Product Strategy & Roadmap Support**

* Contribute to product roadmap planning and execution
* Align feature development with overall product vision and business objectives
* Incorporate stakeholder input, user feedback, and analytics insights

**3. Technical Collaboration**

* Translate business requirements into clear technical specifications
* Work closely with engineering teams on solution design and implementation
* Assess technical trade-offs, dependencies, and constraints
* Ensure adherence to scalability, security, and performance standards

**4. Agile Delivery Execution**

* Actively participate in Agile ceremonies (sprint planning, grooming, stand-ups, retrospectives)
* Ensure timely and high-quality delivery of product increments
* Support continuous improvement in development and delivery processes

**5. Stakeholder Management**

* Collaborate with business, engineering, and UX/design teams
* Act as the primary point of contact for owned features
* Communicate progress, risks, and outcomes effectively

**6. Data-Driven Decision Making**

* Define and track KPIs for product features
* Use product analytics and user insights to drive improvements
* Optimize product performance, usability, and adoption

**7. Product Lifecycle Support**

* Support the full product lifecycle including requirement gathering, development, testing, and release
* Assist in documentation, training, and user adoption initiatives

Ensure smooth rollout and continuous enhancement of features

  

**Required Knowledge And Experiences**

The ideal candidate should have 5–8 years of experience in Technical Product Management, Product Management, or software/program delivery roles, with a strong understanding of the product lifecycle and Agile methodologies. They should possess solid knowledge of SDLC, ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications, and familiarity with tools like Jira and Confluence. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills are essential, along with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams. A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field is required, with Agile certifications (CSPO/CSM) considered an added advantage.
